proposed_comments.body:
### Map specific Mouse Utilities products before the fallback

**Severity:** `medium`

`CursorWrap` currently reaches the generic `src/modules/MouseUtils/` fallback, so PRs for that module would be labeled as Mouse Utilities instead of Cursor Wrap. The slash-terminated `MouseJump/` prefix also misses the real sibling projects such as `MouseJump.Common` and `MouseJump.WinUI3`, which produces the same fallback label for Mouse Jump changes. Add the specific Cursor Wrap entry and broaden the Mouse Jump stem before the fallback.

```suggestion
export const PRODUCT_PATH_LABEL_MAP = [
  ['src/modules/MouseUtils/CursorWrap/', 'Product-Cursor Wrap'],
  ['src/modules/MouseUtils/FindMyMouse/', 'Product-Find My Mouse'],
  ['src/modules/MouseUtils/MouseHighlighter/', 'Product-Mouse Highlighter'],
  ['src/modules/MouseUtils/MouseJump', 'Product-Mouse Jump'],
  ['src/modules/MouseUtils/MousePointerCrosshairs/', 'Product-Mouse Pointer Crosshairs'],
  ['src/modules/MouseUtils/', 'Product-Mouse Utilities'],
```
